{"consolidated_memory":"MULTIPLE OCCASIONS OF MISSING STEP ERRORS IN analytics/dashboards/funnel.py

All three occasions exhibited the same problem signature: missing step in the funnel report, manifesting as a stage with zero users between two populated ones. All three used the same repro procedure: build the funnel for the two week window. All work was in the analytics/dashboards/funnel.py file on the analytics side. The covering test file is tests/analytics/test_funnel.py. Stack: Python.

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-27]
- Trigger condition: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #4877 on branch fix/missing-step-1
- Result: error rate dropped from 2.4 percent to under 6 per ten thousand (approximately 0.06%)

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-08]
- Trigger condition: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: an off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #5999 on branch fix/missing-step-2
- Result: the backlog cleared 50 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 3: [2026-08-31]
- Trigger condition: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #8234 on branch fix/missing-step-3
- Result: p99 latency fell from 3.5 s to 637 ms"}
